hypotheses.statement: For string/bytes dynamic ABI round-trips, solc and solang produce semantically identical values (UTF-8 strings incl. astral-plane chars, empty strings, >31-byte strings, bytes hex, string arrays), but the storage oracle reports false divergences because raw EVM 32-byte slots vs solang SCALE-packed storage layouts differ in entry count and values even for identical contract state.

evidence.note: All semantic queries (stored, lastConcat, blob, getNames, echoNames) passed; only raw storage multiset differed (6 vs 3/2/1 entries) which is expected layout difference, triaged as oracle_artifact.

hypotheses.next_probe: Re-run the same string/bytes probe with the storage oracle disabled and events oracle restricted to getter return values (setString -> query stored, setBytes -> query blob, etc.), asserting semantic equality; also compare storage before vs after a no-op step to isolate layout noise.

hypotheses.statement: The event comparator normalizes string event args to identical values but renders an empty bytes value as '0x' on EVM and '' on Polkadot, producing a false EVENT_MISMATCH on every Stored event emitted before setBytes runs.

evidence.note: Both EVENT_MISMATCH divergences at steps 0 and 2 differ solely in b: '0x' (evm) vs '' (polkadot) while s matched exactly.

hypotheses.next_probe: Emit an event with an empty bytes arg plus a fixed non-empty bytes arg on both chains; check whether the comparator flags only the empty-arg field, then patch normalization to treat '0x' == '' for bytes values.

hypotheses.statement: solang packs dynamic string/bytes state into fewer storage cells than solidity's slot-per-word layout (observed 3 nonzero entries on polkadot vs 6 on EVM after storing stored, lastConcat, and a 32-byte blob), so storage 'count' mode will flag any stateful dynamic-type probe as divergent regardless of correctness.

evidence.note: After setBytes, EVM shows 6 slots vs polkadot 3 for the same three logical state variables; counts diverge at every stateful step.

hypotheses.next_probe: Instrument the harness to snapshot storage layout per chain after deploying an empty contract: if empty-contract layouts already differ, mark storage-count oracle as unusable for cross-chain comparison in this seed area.
